title: Fitting quantum machine learning potentials to experimental free energy data: Predicting tautomer ratios in solution
summary: Quantum machine-learning potentials fitted to experimental free-energy data support alchemical calculations of tautomer ratios; on an independent 71-pair test set the optimized QML RMSE fell from 6.6 to 3.1 kcal/mol. This is a bounded computational chemistry result, not an experimentally discovered drug effect.
